name: skillselion
description: Search and load community agent skills (real SKILL.md files with their scripts), MCP servers and plugin marketplaces from the Skillselion catalog, ranked by installs. Read-only, no sign-in.

interface.longDescription:
Skillselion is a catalog of more than 80,000 community agent skills, MCP servers and plugin marketplaces for coding agents, ranked by real installs and GitHub stars.

With this plugin you can:
- Search skills, MCP servers and marketplaces by task or tool name.
- Load one skill: its SKILL.md, the list of its bundled files and two alternatives.
- Read any bundled script, reference or template of a loaded skill.
- Merge the rules of the top matching skills into one deduplicated checklist, each rule tagged with its source.
- See the most-installed skills and most-starred MCP servers.

Intended for developers who use coding agents. Every tool is read-only and needs no account. Skills are community-authored and open source; each result names its source repository so you can review it before you apply it. The plugin does not write to your files or install anything.

positive.description: Load a skill for a coding task
positive.prompt: Find a skill for writing Playwright end-to-end tests and load it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one community Playwright testing skill: its SKILL.md text, the list of its bundled files, the source repository, and up to two alternative skills.

positive.description: Read a bundled file of a loaded skill
positive.prompt: Show me one of the bundled files of that Playwright skill.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the full text of one file listed under Bundled files in the load_skill result, headed by the skill id and file path.

positive.description: Search the catalog for MCP servers
positive.prompt: Search Skillselion for an MCP server that works with Postgres.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 8 Postgres MCP server listings, each with a summary, GitHub stars or installs, the repository and a skillselion.com link.

positive.prompt: What are the 5 most-installed Claude Code skills on Skillselion right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the top 5 skills ranked by installs, each with its install count, summary, install command and a skillselion.com link.

positive.prompt: Combine the community skills on React component testing into one checklist for my Vite app.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a deduplicated list of rules merged from up to 5 React testing skills, each rule tagged with its source skill, plus the source skill ids.
